title: Viral Titration of SARS-COV-2 by Plaque Assay (Semi-Solid Agarose)
author: Björn eyer
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.be4zjgx6
materials: Melt Agarose in the microwave until liquified.

steps.title: Prepare 2x Overlay Media
steps.instruction: Prepare the semi-solid agarose overlay medium.

substeps.instruction: Mix 455 mL MEM with 20 mL FBS.
Dissolve 0.6 g Agarose in 30 mL H2O.
Quickly add 25 mL melted Agarose to the prewarmed media.
Close the bottle and shake vigorously for 30 seconds, repeating 3-4 more times over a 10-minute period.
Allow the solution to cool at room temperature (can be stored at 4 °C for reuse).

steps.title: Seed Vero E6 Cells
steps.instruction: Seed cells into plates for the assay.

substeps.instruction: Plate 24-well plates with 7.5x10^4 Vero E6 cells per well in 10% FBS/DMEM.

steps.title: Perform Serial Dilutions of Virus
steps.instruction: Prepare viral dilutions in a 96-well plate (perform steps in BSL-3 setting).

substeps.instruction: Add 270 µL serum-free MEM to each well of a 96-well plate.
Add 30 µL viral solution to the first row (A) and mix thoroughly.
Transfer 30 µL from row A to row B.
Repeat the transfer process from row C through row H.

steps.title: Inoculate Cells
steps.instruction: Apply viral dilutions to the cell monolayer.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 250 µL of each dilution into each well.
Incubate at 37 °C for 1 hour, rocking the plate every 15 minutes.

steps.title: Apply Overlay Media
steps.instruction: Seal the inoculum with the semi-solid overlay.

substeps.instruction: Prewarm the 2x overlay media while cells are incubating.
After 1 hour of absorption, add 250 µL of 2x overlay media on top of the 250 µL inoculum (final volume 500 µL per well).
Incubate at 37 °C for approximately 65 hours.

steps.title: Fix and Stain Cells
steps.instruction: Fix the cells and stain for plaque visualization.

substeps.instruction: Prepare crystal violet solution by mixing 100 mL crystal violet, 200 mL EtOH, and 700 mL water.
Add approximately 500 µL of 4% formalin to each well on top of the overlay media.
Let the plate sit for 20 to 30 minutes at room temperature.
Remove the media from the well plate.
Add a solution of 0.25% Crystal Violet and 20% Ethanol in water to each well.
Let the plate sit for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Plunge the well-plate into a first bucket filled with 1% bleach diluted in water.
Plunge the well-plate into a second bucket filled with water.

description: Count plaques against a white background.
